title.en: Medical (Therapy, Education and Research) (Approved Hospitals and Medical Schools) Notification 2010

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Medical (Therapy, Education and Research) (Approved Hospitals and Medical Schools) Notification 2010.

2. The Minister declares —
(a)the hospitals specified in Part 1 of the Schedule to be approved hospitals for the purposes of the Act; and
(b)the medical schools specified in Part 2 of the Schedule to be approved medical schools for the purposes of the Act.

THE SCHEDULE

Part 2
